intro: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak is a task offered by the eccentric artisan Bartolo Ginsetti in Southshore. Bartolo claims to craft an Alliance-renowned mantle of peerless quality, requiring adventurers to collect tailoring staples, a leatherworker's cloak, and raw yeti pelts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, Alliance renowned, Yeti Fur Cloak!
Travel the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you. Oh wait, what is that, little traveler? "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!" Yes, yes! That, I have heard before.
Bartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a skilled leatherworker, Fine Thread and Yeti Fur, of course! Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
